notes:
Lead came through marketing signup (small credits). Self-serve trial active since 2026-02-22. Main contact: CTO - Lila Gomez <lila@brightmarsh.ai>. First support ticket: high latency reported from EU users on chat endpoint. They are using hosted_api, default region (us-west). They said: "responses are frequently >1.2s token latency and conversations feel laggy for EU customers". Observations and AE/SE notes:
- Trial usage: ~10k tokens/day, mostly chat completions (conversational support bot).
- Using streaming + long multi-turn prompts (average 1,400 tokens per request including history).
- Client timeout on front-end is currently 2s — causing aborted responses for some requests.
- They are sensitive to latency; cost is secondary but want predictable UX.
- No dedicated capacity; public cloud only for now. Interested in simple fixes before committing.
Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-22: Self-serve signup, trial credits granted, AE intro email (Aisha).
- 2026-02-25: First Fireflies call; demo of hosted_api & quickstart. (ff_20260302_3645)
- 2026-03-01: Support ticket JIRA-RED-1223 opened describing EU latency spikes.
- 2026-03-02: SE (Miguel) did initial trace, suggested region switch and shorter prompts.
- 2026-03-04: Client confirmed lower latency when routing test traffic to eu-west (manual), but inconsistent.
- 2026-03-05: Quick follow-up call; asked for written perf tuning checklist and sample timeout settings.
Use-case and technical requirements summary:
- Workload: chat-first support assistant with contextual history + occasional embeddings for retrieval.
- Latency goal: P95 < 600ms for token streaming for EU users; currently hitting 900-1,400ms on default setup.
- Throughput: low (50-200 reqs/min) but real-time UX required.
- Model preference: open models (gpt-like family) with CPU/GPU inferred choices; willing to test quantized variants.
- Routing: wants simple region routing (EU users -> eu-west) and fallback to US if EU capacity constrained.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation preferred, audit logs required for security review.
SE troubleshooting notes / recommended quick wins (provided by Miguel):
- Region choice: switch hosted_api region to eu-west for EU-heavy traffic; verify DNS + CORS settings.
- Timeout settings: increase frontend timeout to 8s for streaming sessions; set server-side read_timeout 12s.
- Prompt engineering: trim conversation history to last 3 turns, move long docs to embeddings retrieval (reduce prompt token count). Aim for <800 tokens per request.
- Batch/caching: enable prefix KV caching for repeated greetings and canned answers.
- Streaming param tweaks: lower chunk_size and ensure client processes partial frames to reduce perceived latency.
Next steps / open items:
- Send perf tuning checklist + sample curl examples by 2026-03-06 (AE/SE action).
- Offer 1-week EU routing test with small traffic split (SE to configure guidance).
- Client to try region switch and report P95 numbers; if unresolved, discuss Dedicated trial.
